title: RepoMesh Review Receipt v1
description: 200 response of POST /api/v1/agent-actions/leader/assignments/{taskId}/review. Frozen verdict-to-outcome mapping (pinned by contract tests): approve -> leaderTaskStatus succeeded, reworkTaskIds empty; request_rework -> leaderTaskStatus in_progress, reworkTaskIds non-empty (the new revision worker tasks, created idempotently per review revision); escalate -> leaderTaskStatus blocked, reworkTaskIds empty. Idempotent resubmission of the same decision against the same reviewRevision returns this same document with 200.

reviewRevision.description: The review round this decision was accepted against; part of the idempotent identity.

leaderTaskStatus.description: Resulting leader task status; values are RepoMesh TaskStatus strings.
